title: A bug with TDDP bind pictures to map plugin

posts.author: Jasanimation
posts.body:
Im pretty new to using this plugin and i when i tried to do a battle cut-in, this error shows up.
Does anyone know whats wrong or am i missing something?

posts.author: KermexRPG
posts.body: Afaik that plugin is really outdated. Why not use Galv's layers plugin instead?

posts.author: Jasanimation
posts.body: thanks for the input ill give that a try

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
said said, the error basically says that a data object is undefined, an object that is supposed to have a property named "top".
Given the context it is highly likely that said data object is either a picture itself or a screen position of where the picture is supposed to be placed -  "top" has to be a reference to a picture position.
Since I consider it unlikely that it is the map that vanished, it is more likely that the picture that was supposed to be bound has been deleted.
for better bughunting you would have to show the events that use the plugin's commands and describe when exactly that error happens.
